end.summary:
Practised choosing exact or approximate values for different situations.
Identified approximate values for headlines and distance examples.
Rounded large numbers to lakh/crore using the next digit.
Explained why school fees need an exact value.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised when to use exact or approximate values, and rounding large numbers to a sensible place. Ayaan explained that fees need exact amounts, while a distance or headline can use an approximate value. They mixed up the rounding step briefly, then corrected it to 3 lakh by checking the ten-thousands digit. At home, ask them to label everyday examples as exact or approximate and explain why.
